scope: Tracker suppliers with structured SEC XBRL quarterly revenue (edgarId in edgarRegistry). Set by source class before results are known (D-89). Derived, never hand-set: a test fails if this list differs from the derived set.
policy: Every certified supplier and group is required. Each claim is re-derived from primary SEC data by an independent verifier that shares no code with the producer. A failed source or mismatch yields no proof and holds the run. No exclusions or disclosure answers without an explicit reviewed entry.
